status: preregistration; calibrated on the disjoint pilot; no model trained on the corpus, no readout fitted
what_this_task_is: a world-model test only: an action-conditioned LeWM-family predictor on frozen DINOv2 final patch tokens pooled to a 4x4 grid, trained on apple-look-v1 train sessions and measured offline; no control formulation preregistered or implied
control_lines: CEM abandoned as the primary control line at TASK-054; the behaviour-cloning line stopped at TASK-057; both clauses hold; no control formulation preregistered or implied

predecessor.clause_closed: an action-conditioned LeWM-family predictor on frozen, externally pretrained pooled (CLS) latents on apple-look-v1

facts.G2_G4: passed on all three seeds at h = 8 and 16
facts.G1: failed on effective rank alone: ratio 0.365-0.399 against an uncalibrated 0.5
facts.G5: failed: 0.94-1.19 cm predicted against 0.68-0.83 cm encoded

halves.rule: sorted train sessions permuted by default_rng(65); first 85 = A
halves.probe_roots: cross-fitted: each train root predicted by the half model that never trained on it, read by the probe fold that held it out

model.latent: DINOv2 ViT-S/14 final patch tokens (after the final LayerNorm), 16x16 average-pooled to 4x4 (float64 mean, float32), 6144-d, row-major (row, column, channel)
model.predictor: pinned upstream LeWM ARPredictor (num_frames = 16 tokens) + Embedder + pred_proj via upstream JEPA.predict; token grid as the sequence axis; action embedding per frame broadcast over tokens by AdaLN-zero; attention bidirectional within the frame

option.class: frozen_token_model(BACKEND): FrozenTokenMixin(FrozenEncoderMixin) in front of the backend
option.off_unless_selected: plain backends and the CLS class reject token_grid; the token class requires both keys

frozen_encoder.name: dinov2_small_tokens
frozen_encoder.input: 112 px uint8 -> 224 px bicubic, no crop, ImageNet normalisation

arms.N: every action zero in training and evaluation (no-action baseline)

calibration.leakage: latent-space quantities only; no label read; no apple readout; no corpus episode opened; no test split

rules.budget: U = clamp(5000 * ceil(2 * max u_sat / 5000), 10000, 30000); escalate if 2 * max u_sat > 30000; u_sat = first point within 1 % of the run's min criterion
rules.G1_bars: floor(100 * 0.5 * min over W seeds and h in {8,16} of the pilot ratio) / 100; escalate if the rank reference < 0.10

pre_freeze_checks.controls: outputs/task066-calibration/controls-1/report.json: combined G1 fails truncations k = 1, 2, 4, 8; untruncated pilot W passes (tree dirty in the task card only)
pre_freeze_checks.pilot_readability: outputs/task066-calibration/readability-3/report.json: the pooling rule fired (4x4 upper ratio 0.644 / 0.618 at h = 8 / 16, P-tok 0.588 / 0.540); pilot judged uninformative
pre_freeze_checks.corpus_ceiling: outputs/task066-calibration/ceiling-1/report.json: encoded 4x4 meets T1 on 190 roots (0.607 / 0.492 cm, upper 0.381 / 0.320 at h = 8 / 16); keep 4x4

training.sampler: TASK-065's default_rng(SeedSequence([6500, seed, half index])), shared by W and N

evaluation.E_all: every train window of 16 transitions starting at every 4th frame, predicted by the other half's model
evaluation.E_post: the 170 train roots from frame 8 with their executed actions

probe.readouts: info_ceiling nested CV (linear + RBF kernel ridge, lambda 1e-4..1e4)
probe.fit_on: encoded pooled 4x4 token grid (6144-d, raw) of frame 8 + h of the 170 train roots, 10-fold CV

evaluation.ceiling: the encoded 4x4 grid of frame 8 + h meets the TASK-059 T1 bar at h = 8 and 16 on the 170 train roots (selects WM-TOK-CEILING; not a gate)

gates.ceiling: the encoded grid of frame 8 + h meets the T1 bar at h = 8 and 16 (selects row WM-TOK-CEILING; not a gate)
gates.per_seed_rule: a gate passes for a seed only if it passes at h = 8 and h = 16; the seed passes if G1-G5 all pass

guards_void_the_run: G-cache (a: cache path bit-identical; b: two whole episodes with partial final batches bit-identical; c: pooled cache rows within 1e-3 of pooled anchor rows)

pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.V: a guard fails or the run stops early; nothing is read; one repeat
pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.WM-TOK-UNSTABLE: one or two seeds pass; clause does not fire
pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.WM-TOK-CEILING: no seed passes; G1-G4 on >= 2 seeds; the encoded grid misses the T1 bar at h = 8 or 16; clause does not fire
pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.WM-TOK-APPLE-LOST: no seed passes; G1-G4 on >= 2 seeds; clause fires
pre_declared_outcomes_in_order.WM-TOK-COLLAPSE: no seed passes; G2-G4 on >= 2 seeds; clause fires

inconclusive_task_level: a second V closes TASK-066 as INCONCLUSIVE; the clause does not fire

abandonment_clause.closes: an action-conditioned LeWM-family predictor on frozen, externally pretrained DINOv2 patch-token latents on apple-look-v1, including pooling grid and resolution, history, attention masking, action chunking, step embeddings, loss weighting, capacity, residual parameterisation and budget
untested_not_refuted: a trainable encoder initialised from the pretrained one
another observation (the fixed overview camera; an owner decision)

void_rule: an early stop is V with a void_reason; one from-scratch repeat into run-2 with the same seeds, caps and device and recomputed features; a second V is INCONCLUSIVE; any guard change needs an owner ruling; rulings recorded with a UTC timestamp
run_command: uv run --no-sync python scripts/train_apple_token_dynamics.py run --output outputs/task066-token-dynamics/run-1 --checkpoints checkpoints/task066-token-dynamics/run-1

option A: keep 4x4 subject to an encoded-only ceiling pre-check on the 190 train + val corpus roots, rule written before it ran; result: keep 4x4
